svg.title: SWE-bench Verified: 100 Django issues at a 16K window, each setting against the ceiling of its run
svg.desc: Cost relative to the ceiling with 95% intervals and issues resolved, for Haiku and Sonnet. Over three runs the lean settings cost 80 to 81% of the ceiling on Sonnet and 96 to 100% on Haiku, and resolve as many issues. The adaptive workspace costs more. EoCC alone costs 74 to 85% but resolves 5 fewer issues than its ceiling on both models.
svg.text: SWE-bench Verified, 100 Django issues at a 16K window: cost against the ceiling of the same run
Dot: cost as a share of the ceiling's. Line: 95% interval over workdays. Right: issues resolved of 100 by the setting · by its ceiling (means over the runs).
